label: Agents
title: Agents Settings
subtitle: Create and manage the agents available across all projects.
description: The Agents tab is the global registry for every agent in your InnoviumAI instance. Agents defined here are the defaults; any project can override individual fields without modifying the global definition.

settings.name: Name & Description
settings.description: Identifies the agent in the UI and is used by auto-discovery to match it to relevant tasks.

settings.name: Agent Type
settings.description: Simple (single-task end-to-end), PI (multi-phase project manager), or MCP (external service bridge).

settings.name: System Prompt
settings.description: Instructions that always prefix the agent's context, shaping its persona and reasoning style.

settings.name: Tools
settings.description: Which tools this agent can invoke. Only enabled tools appear in the agent's reasoning loop.

settings.name: Skills
settings.description: Reusable instruction sets added to the agent's context manually or through auto-discovery.

settings.name: Workflows
settings.description: Pre-defined multi-step procedures the agent can execute when needed.

settings.name: Knowledge Databases
settings.description: Additional shared or custom vector databases the agent can query. Its current project's primary database is always available without an assignment.

settings.name: Enable / Disable
settings.description: Suppress or expose an agent globally without deleting its configuration.

mediaCaption: The global Agents tab with the agent list on the left and the configuration panel open on the right
tips: Disabling an agent hides it from all projects without losing any of its settings — useful for temporarily removing an agent during testing.
Keep system prompts focused: a short, precise prompt outperforms a long one that covers every edge case.
